current_project_meta.name: word2vec-skipgram
current_project_meta.title: Word2Vec Skip-Gram with Negative Sampling from Scratch
current_project_meta.description: A Word2Vec skip-gram model built from scratch in NumPy/PyTorch on a small corpus - text preprocessing with frequency-based subsampling and dynamic-window (center, context) pairs, input/output embedding matrices trained with negative sampling against a unigram^(3/4) noise distribution, then embedding evaluation with cosine-similarity analogies and a t-SNE map
daily_plan: Text preprocessing - tokenization, frequency-filtered vocabulary, Mikolov subsampling of frequent words, and dynamic-window skip-gram (center, context) pair generation
Skip-gram model with input/output embedding matrices and the negative-sampling loss using a unigram^(3/4) noise distribution
Training loop over subsampled pairs with negative sampling, learning-rate schedule, and periodic nearest-neighbor sanity checks
Embedding evaluation - cosine-similarity word analogies, nearest neighbours, t-SNE visualization, project README

completed_projects.name: seq2seq-attention-translation
completed_projects.title: Neural Machine Translation with Seq2Seq + Attention
completed_projects.description: An encoder-decoder LSTM with Bahdanau attention built from scratch in PyTorch for word-level translation - the parallel-corpus data pipeline and vocabularies, a bidirectional-LSTM encoder with additive attention, teacher-forced training with masked cross-entropy, then greedy/beam decoding, BLEU evaluation and attention heatmaps
daily_plan: Parallel-corpus data pipeline - tokenization, per-side vocabulary with <pad>/<sos>/<eos>/<unk>, padded batches and reported source lengths
Bidirectional-LSTM encoder and the Bahdanau (additive) attention module scoring the decoder state against encoder outputs with padding masks
Attention decoder and the teacher-forcing training loop with masked cross-entropy and gradient clipping
Greedy and beam-search decoding, BLEU evaluation, attention-heatmap visualization, project README

completed_projects.name: unet-segmentation-oxford-pets
completed_projects.title: U-Net Semantic Segmentation on Oxford-IIIT Pet
completed_projects.description: A U-Net built from scratch in PyTorch for pixel-wise segmentation of the Oxford-IIIT Pet dataset - a symmetric encoder/decoder with skip connections, joint image/mask augmentation, a combined cross-entropy + soft Dice loss, the training loop with a mean-IoU metric, then qualitative mask overlays and per-class evaluation
daily_plan: Oxford-IIIT Pet data pipeline - joint image/mask transforms, trimap {1,2,3} -> class {0,1,2} remapping, resize/normalize, train/val split
U-Net from scratch - double-conv block, the downsampling encoder and upsampling decoder with skip-connection concatenation
Combined cross-entropy + soft Dice loss and the training loop with Adam, per-epoch mean-IoU on the validation set
Qualitative mask overlays, per-class IoU breakdown, loss/IoU curves, project README

completed_projects.name: vision-transformer-cifar
completed_projects.title: Vision Transformer (ViT) from Scratch on CIFAR-10
completed_projects.description: A Vision Transformer built from scratch in PyTorch for CIFAR-10 classification - patch embedding with a class token and learnable positional embeddings, multi-head self-attention and the transformer encoder block, the full model with an AdamW + cosine training loop, then evaluation, attention-map visualization, and a CNN baseline comparison
daily_plan: CIFAR-10 data pipeline with augmentation, patch embedding (conv-as-linear), class token and learnable positional embeddings
Scaled dot-product attention, multi-head self-attention, and the pre-norm transformer encoder block (attention + MLP, residuals)
Full ViT assembly (embedding + encoder stack + classification head) and the training loop with AdamW, cosine LR schedule and label smoothing
Test-set evaluation, attention-map visualization over the CLS token, small-CNN baseline comparison, loss/accuracy curves, project README

completed_projects.name: dcgan-fashion-mnist
completed_projects.title: Deep Convolutional GAN (DCGAN) on Fashion-MNIST
completed_projects.description: A DCGAN built from scratch in PyTorch generating 28x28 Fashion-MNIST images - strided/transposed convolutional generator and discriminator following the DCGAN architectural recipe, the adversarial training loop, then sampling and latent-space interpolation
daily_plan: Fashion-MNIST data pipeline normalised to [-1,1], DCGAN generator (transposed conv) and discriminator (strided conv) architectures with DCGAN weight init
BCEWithLogits adversarial losses, real/fake label conventions with one-sided label smoothing, and the alternating G/D training step
Full training loop with separate Adam optimisers (beta1=0.5), fixed-noise sample grids per epoch, and mode-collapse / loss monitoring
Final sample grid, latent-space interpolation between two noise vectors, generator/discriminator loss curves, project README

completed_projects.name: contrastive-learning-simclr
completed_projects.title: Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning (SimCLR) on CIFAR-10
completed_projects.description: SimCLR-style representation learning in PyTorch on CIFAR-10 - stochastic augmentation pipeline, an encoder with a projection head, the NT-Xent contrastive loss, then a linear-probe evaluation of the learned features
daily_plan: Augmentation pipeline (crop, color jitter, grayscale, blur) producing two correlated views per image
ResNet encoder with an MLP projection head, feature/embedding shapes
NT-Xent contrastive loss with cosine similarity, temperature, and in-batch negatives
Self-supervised training, frozen-encoder linear probe accuracy, t-SNE of embeddings, project README

completed_projects.name: char-transformer-shakespeare
